overview: Bill Bridge India is a billing, stock and ledger app for businesses. This policy explains what the app collects, why, and the choices you have. The app works with an account on your company's Bill Bridge India software; the business that owns the account controls its business records.
collect: Account details: name, email address and phone number you or your company administrator enter.
Business records you create: parties (customers and suppliers), items and stock, invoices, payments, ledgers and company details such as GSTIN and address.
Company logo, only if you choose to upload one.
Basic technical data needed to run the service, such as sign-in sessions and server logs.
use: To sign you in and show you the records your role is allowed to see.
To create, store and share invoices and reports.
To keep the service secure and fix faults.
sharing: Your data is stored on servers run by LM Software Solutions. It is shown only to users of your own company account, according to their role. It is shared outside only if you share an invoice yourself, or if the law requires it. The app does not include advertising or third-party analytics SDKs.
permissions: Camera: to scan item barcodes. Images are not stored or uploaded.
Photos: only the picture you pick as your company logo.
Fingerprint / face unlock: to unlock the app on your phone. Biometric data stays on your device and is never sent to us.
retention: We keep your data while your account is active. Saved invoices and ledger entries are never edited or deleted one by one inside the app, because accounting and tax rules require a complete record; mistakes are fixed by returns or corrections. When an admin deletes the business, all its data is removed from the app for every user straight away. Permanent erasure is described on the account deletion page.
delete_steps_html:
Option 1: delete your business in the app (admins)

  1. Sign in as an admin of the business. Only admins see this option.
  2. Open More, then Business settings.
  3. Scroll to the bottom and tap Delete this business.
  4. Type the business name to confirm, then tap Delete for ever.
Warning: all bills, parties, items and money records of the business are removed from the app for everyone who uses it. You cannot undo this in the app.

Option 2: ask us to erase everything permanently

Deleting a business in the app removes it from view. To have the data permanently erased from our servers, or to delete your own login (name, email address, phone number), email us:

  1. Send an email to info@lmsoftwaresolutions.com from the address registered on your account, with the subject Delete my Bill Bridge India data.
  2. Include your name, business name and phone number so we can find the account.
  3. We will confirm your identity, erase the data and reply within 30 days.

If you are staff and not an admin, ask your business admin to delete the business, or email us to remove only your own login. Your business keeps the records you created.
deleted: Business data: parties, items, stock, bills, payments, ledgers, company details and logo (removed from the app when an admin deletes the business; permanently erased on request).
Your user login, name, email address and phone number (on request by email).
Your sign-in sessions and device unlock settings.
kept: Invoices and ledger entries that must be retained under Indian GST and income-tax rules, until the legally required period ends. If a staff login is deleted, entries they created stay in the business's records without personal contact details.
Backups are overwritten on their normal schedule, within 35 days.
